title: Anthropic launches roadshow for proposed initial public offering

quotes.text: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
The proposed offering consists of 825,000,000 shares of Class A common stock.
The initial public offering price is expected to be between $70.00 and $78.00 per share.
Anthropic has applied to list its Class A common stock on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol “ANT.”
Of these, 801,351,354 shares are being offered by Anthropic and
23,648,646 shares are being offered by certain existing stockholders.
quotes.for: The shares offered by existing stockholders.

quotes.text: Anthropic will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders.
quotes.for: No proceeds to Anthropic from the selling stockholders.

quotes.text: Anthropic also expects to grant the underwriters a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 123,750,000 shares
A registration statement relating to these securities has been filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission but has not yet become effective.
